answer: The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, slashed on a failed audit, rewards vest against future work. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Reaching the glacier of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the grove of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the ledge re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
